description: Asked in their own words what consciousness is, 89% of 202 members of the public described it as receptive, a possessing, knowing or perceiving of content. 33% gave an agentic view and 10% a mystical one, and only two mentioned anything like selective attention.
limitations: A preprint with an online sample. It describes folk usage and does not test AST.

sources.quote: Almost all people (89%) described consciousness as fundamentally receptive
Only two participants mentioned any property resembling selective attention.
